FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Yeah, so we had a situation here near Edmonton. Got a call from one of the field guys at 19:38
tonight, October 26. Says he noticed the pipeline wasn't acting right-was being operated
outside its design limits. No leak or release though, nothing like that. Just the pressure or flow or
something was off spec. Not sure what part of the system yet, but the control room's looking into
it. That's all we've got right now.
- Jake, Field Op
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
